name: Kenco MCS Mississippi - Olive Branch MS

fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. Truck courts on both long faces are open and connect freely to S Distribution Cove; no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint visible in z18-z20 satellite or Street View. Property is an open multi-tenant logistics-park building.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth anywhere on the property; S end has only an office and a paved truck turnaround/roundabout.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building: a long dock bank on the W face and a separate long dock bank on the E face — physically distinct clusters.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive striped trailer-parking drop yards on both the W and E sides, dozens of stalls each — banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long continuous dock banks on both long faces of an ~800,000 SF cross-dock; banded 50+. Door count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town greenfield logistics park beside an airport runway, surrounded by farmland; judged Rural.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~90 trailers counted across both drop yards / dock aprons; approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimated 200 from the two large striped drop yards; low confidence.
